effects.film_grain: Implement CSS noise via repeating-radial-gradient or SVG filter, low opacity (5-10%), mix-blend-overlay. Adds analog film texture.

layouts.page: 100vh h-screen w-full overflow-hidden relative flex items-center justify-center. Cinematic framing.
layouts.chat_container: w-full max-w-4xl mx-auto p-6 md:p-8 flex flex-col gap-6 relative z-10

elements.background: Dark cinematic overlay (bg-black/80) over the subtle fabric texture.
elements.play_button: Center stage. 120px circular glassmorphic button (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/5 border border-white/20). Hover: scale up slightly, border brightens. Lucide Play icon.
elements.title: Cormorant Garamond, text-6xl+, text-[#F9F8F6], tracking-tighter.
elements.controls_cluster: Top right absolute. Share Link, Mute, Restart. Subtle text-[#94A3B8] hover:text-[#F9F8F6].

player_chrome.container: Flex row, items-center gap-4 px-6 py-3 rounded-full bg-[#0A0A0A]/80 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/10
player_chrome.timeline: h-1 w-64 md:w-96 bg-[#0F172A] rounded-full overflow-hidden relative. Fill bar is bg-[#C7A76D]. Chapter markers are absolute w-[2px] h-full bg-black/50.

brain_chat.description: The centerpiece UI replicating the SaaS.
brain_chat.user_bubble: bg-[#F9F8F6] text-[#0A0A0A] rounded-2xl rounded-tr-sm px-5 py-3 max-w-[80%] self-end font-medium text-base shadow-md

tool_pill.running: Inline flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full bg-[#0F172A] border border-[#C7A76D]/50 px-4 py-2 text-sm text-[#C7A76D] animate-pulse
tool_pill.completed: Inline flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full bg-[#571326]/20 border border-[#571326] px-4 py-2 text-sm text-[#F9F8F6] transition-all duration-500

brain_chat.insight_callout: mt-4 bg-[#C7A76D]/10 border-l-2 border-[#C7A76D] p-5 text-[#F9F8F6] text-sm md:text-base shadow-sm
brain_chat.kpi_cards: bg-[#0F172A]/50 border border-white/5 rounded-xl p-5 flex flex-col justify-center items-start
brain_chat.preview_confirm: Interactive UI block: 'Review Bulk Update' header, data table snippet, and 'Confirm' button (bg-[#C7A76D] text-black hover:bg-[#F9F8F6]). Transitions to 'Executed' status with green/champagne check.

captions.position: absolute bottom-24 w-full flex justify-center z-40 pointer-events-none
captions.style: bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-md px-6 py-2 rounded-lg text-[#F9F8F6] text-lg md:text-xl font-medium tracking-wide max-w-3xl text-center shadow-lg

closing_cta.content: Fade in 'Ready to power your loyalty program?'. Large 'Book a Demo' button (bg-[#F9F8F6] text-[#0A0A0A] rounded-full px-8 py-4 font-semibold hover:scale-105 transition-transform). 'Replay Reel' secondary button.

motion.typing: Framer Motion stagger children (0.02s - 0.05s delay per character).
motion.streaming: Words appear sequentially (opacity 0 -> 1, y 5 -> 0) mimicking LLM generation.
motion.tool_execution: Enter: y=10, opacity=0. Transition to Complete: Width adjusts smoothly (layout animation), color shifts. Results reveal with stagger (0.2s delay).
motion.act_transitions: Cinematic crossfade. Fade chat out to black -> Fade in Act Title Card (Cormorant Garamond, center) -> Fade title out -> Fade in next Chat UI.
motion.kpi_entrance: Scale up slightly (0.95 -> 1) and fade in (opacity 0 -> 1) with spring physics.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure white text on #0F172A > 4.5:1. Champagne on Navy meets contrast requirements.
accessibility.test_ids: Required: data-testid='play-reel-button', data-testid='timeline-progress', data-testid='chat-ui-container', data-testid='tool-pill-status', data-testid='caption-text', data-testid='book-demo-cta'
accessibility.aria: Use aria-live='polite' on the chat streaming area so screen readers announce changes.

image_urls.description: Rich dark fabric background for the cinematic cover overlay.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the /watch route as a dedicated cinematic 'demo reel' view, entirely separate from standard app layouts.
Do not use generic Shadcn cards for the main layout; the main view is a fullscreen cinematic canvas.
Simulate the voiceover/video timeline using a state machine or custom React hook (e.g., useSequence) that triggers UI changes based on simulated timestamps.
Framer Motion is critical here. Use <motion.div layout> for tool pills so they smoothly resize when transitioning from 'Running' to 'Completed'.
Use Recharts with transparent backgrounds and the exact chart_palette for data viz scenes.
Include 'Fundle Brain' (Act 1) and 'Master Brain' (Act 2) distinct sequences. Act 1 focuses on insights/charts. Act 2 focuses on workflow execution (preview -> confirm -> execute).
Ensure 'Manrope' is loaded for UI text and 'Cormorant Garamond' for cinematic headings.
Make sure the UI looks like a real SaaS product overlaid on a film presentation, bringing the Fundle Brain chat screen to life.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not make generic centered layouts. Use glassmorphism and the precise color palette. Implement micro-animations for all tool states. Never use generic placeholder images or emoji icons. This is a premium cinematic sales asset. Do not use Inter; stick strictly to Cormorant Garamond and Manrope. Apply data-testids to all interactive elements. Avoid 'AI slop' aesthetics. Make the demo feel authoritative and high-end.
